    j = 0
    while j < i // 2:
        nums[j], nums[i-j-1] = nums[i-j-1], nums[j]
        j += 1

def max_index(nums, n):
    max_index = 0
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        if nums[max_index] < nums[i]:
            max_index = i
    return max_index

def pancake_sort(nums):
    size = len(nums)
    while size > 1:
        index = max_index(nums, size-1) + 1
        if index != size:
            flip(nums, index-1)
            flip(nums, size-1)
        size -= 1
